prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlalchemy import update
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.core.errors import raise_not_found
+from app.models import Episode, Project, WorkspaceMember
+
+
+def get_episode_project(session: Session, project_id: UUID, user_id: str) -> Project:
+    project = session.exec(
+        select(Project)
+        .join(WorkspaceMember, WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == Project.workspace_id)
+        .where(
+            Project.id == project_id,
+            Project.deleted_at.is_(None),
+            WorkspaceMember.user_id == UUID(user_id),
+        )
+    ).first()
+    if project is None:
+        raise_not_found("project")
+    return project
+
+
+def lock_episode_order(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> None:
+    # SQLite takes a write lock because it does not support SELECT FOR UPDATE.
+    if session.get_bind().dialect.name == "sqlite":
+        session.execute(update(Project).where(Project.id == project_id).values(id=Project.id))
+    else:
+        session.exec(select(Project.id).where(Project.id == project_id).with_for_update()).one()
+
+
+def ordered_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> list[Episode]:
+    return list(session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id, Episode.deleted_at.is_(None))
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at, Episode.id)
+    ).all())
+
+
+def renumber_episodes(episodes: list[Episode]) -> None:
+    for position, episode in enumerate(episodes, 1):
+        if episode.episode_order != position:
+            episode.episode_order = position

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+

+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def create_project(client, headers):
+    response = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title, position):
+    response = client.post(f"{API}/episodes", headers=headers, json={
+        "project_id": project_id,
+        "title": title,
+        "episode_order": position,
+        "story_summary": f"Summary of {title}",
+    })
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    return response.json()["id"]
+
+
+def episode_positions(client, headers, project_id):
+    response = client.get(f"{API}/episodes", headers=headers, params={"project_id": project_id})
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    return [(episode["id"], episode["episode_order"]) for episode in response.json()]
+
+
+def test_restore_reinserts_episode_with_original_cuts(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project_id = create_project(client, headers)["id"]
+    first = create_episode(client, headers, project_id, "Departure", 1)
+    middle = create_episode(client, headers, project_id, "Detour", 2)
+    last = create_episode(client, headers, project_id, "Arrival", 3)
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        session.add_all([
+            StoryCut(
+                episode_id=UUID(middle), cut_order=2, script="The driver turns.",
+                selected_layout="wide", aspect_ratio="16:9", image_path="cuts/detour/turn.png",
+                dialogues=[{"speaker": "Driver", "text": "Hold on."}],
+            ),
+            StoryCut(
+                episode_id=UUID(middle), cut_order=1, script="Rain starts.",
+                selected_layout="single", aspect_ratio="1:1",
+            ),
+        ])
+        session.commit()
+
+    cuts_url = f"{API}/cuts"
+    cuts_params = {"episode_id": middle}
+    cuts = client.get(cuts_url, headers=headers, params=cuts_params).json()
+    assert [cut["cut_order"] for cut in cuts] == [1, 2]
+
+    assert client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{middle}", headers=headers).status_code == 204
+    assert episode_positions(client, headers, project_id) == [(first, 1), (last, 2)]
+    assert client.get(cuts_url, headers=headers, params=cuts_params).json() == []
+
+    restored = client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{middle}/restore", headers=headers)
+    assert restored.status_code == 200, restored.text
+    body = restored.json()
+    assert body["id"] == middle
+    assert body["story_summary"] == "Summary of Detour"
+    assert body["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert body["first_cut_image"] == cuts[1]["image_path"]
+    assert episode_positions(client, headers, project_id) == [(first, 1), (middle, 2), (last, 3)]
+    assert client.get(cuts_url, headers=headers, params=cuts_params).json() == cuts
+
+
+def test_restore_requires_workspace_membership_and_a_deleted_episode(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    member_email = "member@example.com"
+    member = signup(client, email=member_email)
+    project = create_project(client, owner)
+    project_id = project["id"]
+    first = create_episode(client, owner, project_id, "Departure", 1)
+    middle = create_episode(client, owner, project_id, "Detour", 2)
+    last = create_episode(client, owner, project_id, "Arrival", 3)
+    restore_url = f"{API}/episodes/{last}/restore"
+
+    missing = client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{uuid4()}/restore", headers=owner)
+    active = client.post(restore_url, headers=owner)
+    assert active.status_code == missing.status_code == 404
+    assert active.json() == missing.json()
+    assert active.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+    assert client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{last}", headers=owner).status_code == 204
+    assert client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{middle}", headers=owner).status_code == 204
+    denied = client.post(restore_url, headers=member)
+    assert denied.status_code == 404
+    assert denied.json() == missing.json()
+    assert episode_positions(client, owner, project_id) == [(first, 1)]
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        user = session.exec(select(User).where(User.email == member_email)).one()
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=UUID(project["workspace_id"]), user_id=user.id))
+        session.commit()
+
+    restored = client.post(restore_url, headers=member)
+    assert restored.status_code == 200, restored.text
+    assert restored.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert episode_positions(client, member, project_id) == [(first, 1), (last, 2)]
+    assert client.post(restore_url, headers=member).status_code == 404
+    assert episode_positions(client, member, project_id) == [(first, 1), (last, 2)]
